title: Forecasting and decisions
learning_outcomes: Explain resolvable forecasts in the context of forecasting and decisions.
Compare and distinguish reference classes in the context of forecasting and decisions.
Apply expected value in the context of forecasting and decisions.
Evaluate and justify decisions about calibration in the context of forecasting and decisions.

lessons.title: Resolvable forecasts
lessons.outcome: Explain resolvable forecasts in the context of forecasting and decisions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving resolvable forecasts; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to forecast journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain resolvable forecasts from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of resolvable forecasts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reference classes
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish reference classes in the context of forecasting and decisions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reference classes; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to forecast journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reference classes from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reference classes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Expected value
lessons.outcome: Apply expected value in the context of forecasting and decisions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving expected value; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to forecast journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain expected value from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of expected value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Calibration
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about calibration in the context of forecasting and decisions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving calibration; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to forecast journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain calibration from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of calibration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of resolvable forecasts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reference classes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of expected value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of calibration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
